ORS/Zinc provision (Direct evidence)
rows.explainer: We have not found any studies directly estimating the effect of ORS/zinc usage on economic outcomes.

rows.label: Weight (Direct evidence)
ORS/Zinc provision (Cognitive effects)
rows.explainer: Based on no substantial evidence of effect. We have not found any studies directly linking ORS/zinc usage to cognitive outcomes.

rows.label: Weight (Cognitive effects)
ORS/Zinc provision (Growth)
rows.explainer: Based on no substantial evidence of effect. We have not found any studies directly linking ORS/zinc usage to anthropometric outcomes.

rows.label: Weight (Growth)
ORS/Zinc provision (Mortality)
rows.explainer:
Based on compelling evidence suggesting a moderate effect size (10 - 20% reduction)

This is estimated by multiplying 'Total direct and indirect under-5 diarrhea mortality per 1,000 under-5s not receiving ORS with zinc' by 'Effective reduction in mortality from ORS coverage, after IV/EV adjustments' and taking that as the share of 'Under-5 all-cause mortality rate per 1,000'. See 'CEA' tab. For low SDI countries, our estimate is that mortality would be reduced by around 18%.

rows.label: Weight (Mortality)
ORS/Zinc provision (Morbidity)
rows.explainer: Based on uncertain estimates suggesting a small effect size (<200 YLDs per 100,000 person-years).  This effect is due to zinc usage, rather than ORS. See tab 'Supplementary', cells C13 and D13.

rows.label: Weight (Morbidity)
ORS/Zinc provision (Anemia)
rows.explainer: We have not found any studies directly linking ORS/zinc usage to child anemia.

rows.label: Weight (Anemia)
ORS/Zinc provision (Biological plausibility)
rows.explainer: We think this intervention has low plausibility, and a meaningful effect seems neither likely nor unlikely.

rows.label: Weight (Biological plausibility)
ORS/Zinc provision (Weighted average)
rows.formula: sum(ors_zinc_provision_direct_evidence * weight_direct_evidence, ors_zinc_provision_cognitive_effects * weight_cognitive_effects, ors_zinc_provision_growth * weight_growth, ors_zinc_provision_mortality * weight_mortality, ors_zinc_provision_morbidity * weight_morbidity, ors_zinc_provision_anemia * weight_anemia, ors_zinc_provision_biological_plausibility * weight_biological_plausibility)
